verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents official SDKs for TypeScript (@helix-db/helix-db 3.1.0, Node 20+), Go (typed HTTP client), and Python (helix-db 0.3.4 on PyPI), plus Rust, all sharing one operation-tree request model. There is no Java SDK anywhere in the evidence, so one of the four named languages is uncovered; teams on Java would have to use the raw HTTP/OpenAPI contract instead. missing for 10: an official Java SDK, a mature (post-0.x) Python SDK on par with the 3.x TypeScript/Rust versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
